# nemau kubernetes cluster

Manage clusters.

## Usage

```
nemau kubernetes cluster [command]
```

Alias: `clusters`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [create](nemau_kubernetes_cluster_create.md) | Create a cluster |
| [delete](nemau_kubernetes_cluster_delete.md) | Delete a cluster |
| [get](nemau_kubernetes_cluster_get.md) | Show one cluster |
| [kubeconfig](nemau_kubernetes_cluster_kubeconfig.md) | Fetch a cluster's kubeconfig |
| [list](nemau_kubernetes_cluster_list.md) | List the clusters |
| [scale-control-plane](nemau_kubernetes_cluster_scale-control-plane.md) | Change the number of control-plane nodes |
| [upgrade](nemau_kubernetes_cluster_upgrade.md) | Upgrade the Kubernetes version |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
